# Chou Angle Denial Guide

Chou is best when the geometry is solved before the combo starts.

## What to watch

- Pressure safe sidesteps before commit range.
- Use lane state and walls to choose the exit line.
- Reject picks that strand your own damage line.

## Why it matters

The highest-value Chou plays feel effortless because the map was prepared early.

> His best engage is the one the target already lost.

More on Chou: keep this read connected to fighter roam structures, not just isolated mechanics.
